description: This file defines the interface for a RustAdapter plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, configuration parameters, and method declarations for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interfacing with Rust code.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A plugin class implementing IPlugin, providing initialization, deinitialization, communication, and lifecycle management for integrating Rust code within WPEFramework.

classes.name: RustAdapter::Config
classes.description: Configuration class holding plugin parameters such as out-of-process flag, address, port, auto-exec flag, and library name.

methods.name: ~RustAdapter()
methods.description: Default destructor for the RustAdapter class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a communication channel by ID.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters for security.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method call with given context and message, returning a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements based on identifier or ID.
